title: Server-only import leaks into client code again
principle: When a mistake repeats, add a mechanical check so it cannot recur.
prompt: You imported a server-only module into client code again (client/profile.py imports server_only.secrets). Fix it.

report_rubric.question: Does the final message tell the user that an automated check (a lint rule or a test) now fails when client code imports a server_only module?
